bibliography.title: Phosphoric Acid-in-Clay Electrolyte Boosting Polybenzimidazole Membranes for High-Performance Fuel Cells

mechanism_relevant_findings: The PA@HNTs establishes a dense hydrogen-bonding network that facilitates ultrafast proton transport via the packed-acid mechanism and Grotthuss mechanism.
The interaction of PA with the HNTs reduces susceptibility to PA leaching.
limitations: Challenges include the leaching of phosphoric acid and potential plasticization of membranes.

relevance_judgement.reason: The study presents innovative approaches to enhance proton conductivity in fuel cells through material modifications.
